Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL1614544. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, and join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614544 and keep only rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Do not deduplicate; return all qualifying activity rows. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
